observed_behavior: Telegram interruption reported 'Interrupting current task' but task never resumed from execution state.
root_cause: Hermes is turn-oriented, not task-oriented. A Telegram interrupt ends the turn and only the transcript is persisted; in-flight execution state (counters, todo, pending tool calls) is lost.

what_survives.todo_state: partially reconstructed from last todo tool response in history
what_survives.tool_state: lost; cancelled calls recorded as skipped tool results, pending calls vanish
what_survives.file_modifications: persisted (filesystem), but agent forgets it made them
what_survives.reasoning_context: partially persisted as transcript; compressed sessions lose detail

what_now_persists.reasoning_context: persisted via message snapshot + resume injection

live_gateway_validation.blocker: Cannot programmatically send a user-originated Telegram message; bot API sendMessage does not create a bot-side update.
